gloss: to devote oneself completely, to be thorough

definitions.gloss: to devote oneself completely to, to stick to
definitions.explanation: To commit fully to a particular role, attitude, or course of action without wavering. Often used with に to indicate what one devotes oneself to.

definitions.gloss: to last through, to continue throughout
definitions.explanation: To persist or continue all the way through a period of time, especially through the night.

examples.japanese: {沈黙|ちんもく}に{徹|てっ}した。
{裏方|うらかた}に{徹|てっ}して{支|ささ}えてきた。
examples.english: I devoted myself fully to supporting from behind the scenes.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{最後|さいご}まで{自分|じぶん}の{信念|しんねん}に{徹|てっ}した。
examples.english: He stuck completely to his convictions until the end.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}を{徹|てっ}して{議論|ぎろん}した。
examples.english: We debated all through the night.

examples.japanese: {夜|よる}を{徹|てっ}して{勉強|べんきょう}した。
{締|し}め{切|き}りに{間|ま}に{合|あ}わせるため、{夜|よる}を{徹|てっ}して{作業|さぎょう}を{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: To meet the deadline, I continued working all through the night.

notes:
GRAMMAR:
This verb conjugates as a する irregular verb ({徹|てっ}する → {徹|てっ}して → {徹|てっ}した). Sense 1 takes the pattern Xに{徹|てっ}する. Sense 2 is almost exclusively used in the fixed expression {夜|よる}を{徹|てっ}して (all through the night).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {沈黙|ちんもく}に{徹|てっ}する: to maintain complete silence
- {裏方|うらかた}に{徹|てっ}する: to devote oneself to a support role
- {守|まも}りに{徹|てっ}する: to commit fully to defense
- {夜|よる}を{徹|てっ}して: all through the night
